apps.name: Spotube
apps.subtitle: Open-source music streaming
apps.localizedDescription: 🎧 Open source music streaming app! Available for both desktop & mobile!

versions.localizedDescription:
## Spotube V6 is here 🎉🚀

### 🔥Highlights

- Migration from Flutter to Compose Multiplatform, [learn why we did it](https://spotube.cc/blog/compose-multiplatform-migration/)
- UI redesign, introducing [Millennium](https://github.com/team-spotube/millennium/) UI. 2000s look and feel with 2026's modernity
- Jam sessions, play music with friends and family in sync. Runs on a new dedicated room server, with host-only controls and device bans to keep rooms safe
- Full Android Auto integration. Browse, Library, Search all are there now, not just queue
- iOS now plays audio through VLC, so every streaming format works, and keeps playing in the background
- Migration from hetu_script to Kotlin for plugin development. Powered by [Zipline by Cashapp](https://github.com/cashapp/zipline/)
- More extensibility, plugin support for Lyrics provider and Scrobbling providers
- Redesigned plugin manager. Plugin login pages can only reach cookies and scripts of the domains they declare
- Native Android APK, with reduced apk size, performance improvements and more native android integrations.
- Relicensed from BSD-4-Clause to AGPL-3.0-or-later for a more Open Source friendly licensing. And for preventing distribution of closed source and maliciously modified Spotube.

### 💫 Features

- Migration to Compose Multiplatform
- Add ChipTab component and refactor SearchScreen to use it
- Add AutocompleteTextField component and integrate it into SearchScreen
- Enhance AutocompleteTextField with focus management and dropdown behavior
- Enhance AppSidebar with improved button interactions and visual feedback
- Implement endless playback recommendations in DeviceAudioPlayerQueue
- Add GhostIconButton component and enhance button interactions in TrackList
- Replace IconButton with GhostIconButton in AppExpandedPlayer and AppLargePlayer for improved visual consistency
- Replace IconButton with GhostIconButton in PlayerQueueContent and PlayableCard for visual consistency
- Enhance UI components with LocalBaseUITheme for consistent styling and improved interactions
- Enhance button styles and interactions in Buttons and Theme components for improved UI consistency
- Simplify highlight implementation in UI components for improved readability and maintainability
- Add genre selection and tabs to HomeScreen for improved content navigation
- Implement artist overview screen with loading, error handling, and pagination for albums, related artists, and featured playlists
- Add genre and featured browsing capabilities to MediaBrowseHelper
- Implement playlist creation and editing functionality with UI components
- Add 'Add to Playlist' functionality with UI components and dialogs
- Add Toggle component and update UI to use it in place of Switch
- Implement settings section cards for updates, desktop, language, caching, and plugins
- Update icons in settings sections to use Iconsax library for improved UI consistency
- Replace FeatherIcons with Iconsax in PluginCard and PluginPermissionsDialog for improved UI consistency
- Refactor PluginPermissionsDialog to use custom UI components for improved consistency and readability
- Enhance UI with shared element transitions and improve state management in album and playlist screens
- Integrate Uniffi for audio metadata reading and writing with Lofty library
- Replace FeatherIcons with Iconsax in window controls and update sidebar with better design
- Implement haze effect and UI enhancements in AppLargePlayer and AppShell
- Enhance haze effect integration in AppShell and AppSidebar for improved UI experience
- Add adaptive dialog bottom sheet component and enhance plugin installation UI
- Enhance AdaptiveDialogBottomSheet with dismiss icon and improve plugin screen layout
- Implement CollectionView component and refactor Album, Playlist, SavedTracks screens for improved UI consistency
- Add current time management in AudioPlayer for improved playback control
- Simplify playback control logic in AudioPlayer by removing red…

### Bug Fixes

- **newpipe**: Fallback to muxed streams if no audio stream is available
- Dismiss search dropdown and keyboard on submission
- Custom image helper null exception

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KRTirtho/spotube/compare/v5.1.1...v5.1.2

## v5.1.1

### Bug Fixes

- Upgrade NewPipeExtractor to latest version fixing playback issue
- Lyrics not working


## What's Changed
* chore: replace windows app icon by a higher resolution by @TobseF in https://github.com/KRTirtho/spotube/pull/2838

## New Contributors
* @TobseF made their first contribution in https://github.com/KRTirtho/spotube/pull/2838

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KRTirtho/spotube/compare/v5.1.0...v5.1.1

apps.name: Nuvio
apps.subtitle: A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.
apps.localizedDescription:
A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.

Bring your own sources. Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.

versions.localizedDescription:
# Nuvio 1.0.0

Thank you to everyone who has contributed to the project, tested the betas, and supported us along the way.

> [!NOTE]
> On Android, choose **Stable** in **Settings → About → Update channel** for fewer updates and a more stable build. Choose **Beta** for frequent updates, with possible breaking changes. If you were already on a beta build, you stay on **Beta** until you switch.

apps.name: YTKACE
apps.subtitle: YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS with SponsorBlock, background playback, player controls, and interface customization including liquid glass.

versions.localizedDescription:
by @itzzace0

The FlareStore certificate giveaway is still going in the YTKACE Telegram channel: https://t.me/ytkace

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.46.3
• Added Return YouTube Dislike for videos, Shorts and the description panel
• YTKACE and YouTube buttons can now be mixed in the top row and the fullscreen bar
• Added a left button column, and every player button can now be edited in the layout editor
• Added fullscreen bar button toggles
• Added a compact Quality Button and quality settings for AirPlay and Low Power Mode
• Added an option to bypass the Premium device streaming limit
• Added Shorts feed filters for live streams and posts
• Shorts auto-scroll now waits while you read comments
• Reworked Swipe to Seek and hold speed
• PiP now uses native iOS PiP

Fixed:
• Crash when the fullscreen buttons rebuild
• PiP not starting again after a Short or after the first time
• PiP starting when leaving the app with the video paused
• Player download button with HLS
• Captions turning back on after turning them off
• Shorts missing on channels opened from a Short
• Tab bar taps when the Shorts tab is hidden
• Glass tab bar hidden behind incognito and the sleep timer strip
• Controls hiding while using buttons, hold speed seeking, backup restore and title overlap

YouTube 21.46.3 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.8_YouTube_21.46.3.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.8_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

by @itzzace0
